rules: Exactly 20 NEW slots, overall numbers 21–40. Planned concepts do not count as playable.

Only finished, evaluated selections enter the real catalogue. No automatic selection of all candidates.

candidates.title: Reefwright
candidates.coreLoop: Rotate and draft mixed polyomino habitats; maintain sea channels and connected reef ecology.

changes: Two-step touch placement with a rotated footprint preview and explicit Plant confirmation.
Exact before/after habitat and vitality forecast; explicit warning when a placement closes a nursery sea channel.
Toggle sea-channel overlay and expose sea access in cell labels.
Restore offer/grid focus across UI redraws and enable keyboard preview/confirmation.
Visual QA follow-up: compact sticky habitat chooser above the reef on phones, without obstructing successful touch campaigns.
improvementPasses.validation: 21 engine and 19 DOM checks; all five three-medal routes through desktop and touch-emulated Chromium; exact final gameplay CI 39923241054 successful; 14 screenshots, representative desktop and touch images visually inspected.

tests: 21 engine tests: five full three-medal campaigns, species scoring, topology, bounds, mutation isolation, win/loss, undo, replay validation and save integrity.
19 DOM/save/input tests: complete campaign UI actions, exact forecasts, channel-closure warning, reload, restart, keyboard, blocked storage, malformed-save recovery and navigation markup.

Chromium desktop 1280×1000 and touch emulation 390×844: all five coasts through real UI actions, previews, rotation, score forecasts, loss/reopen, persistence, restart/cancel, keyboard traversal, corrupt-save recovery, return navigation and zero uncaught browser errors.
14 screenshots captured; initial and final desktop/mobile samples visually inspected. Compact mobile chooser refinement passed the complete repeat campaign.
19 public routes/assets, nine first-batch selected-source hashes, exact 20-slot second-batch gate, shell, bridge-pointer and relaxed-collection tests passed.
Two inherited launcher tests still target the removed playerStudy control; see baselineTestLimitations.

quality.scale: 1–5, agent design review; not player survey scores
quality.notes: Rotated mixed-species pieces create competing adjacency and open-water goals. Exact previews support deliberate choices without hiding consequences; free undo encourages experimentation. Five different rock layouts/decks and medal optimization offer compact replay. Original sea-glass/SVG presentation is legible on reviewed desktop/touch captures. No randomized campaign, sound layer, physical-device test, full screen-reader audit or human enjoyment study is claimed.

candidates.selectionReason: Retain as a finished development candidate until other second-batch candidates can be compared for enjoyment, depth, polish, reliability and collection variety.

candidates.title: Counterweight
candidates.coreLoop: Operate a crane with shifting ballast to stack and deliver fragile cargo.

changes: Make ballast movement physically consistent with its left/right controls; migrate initial v1 saves by reversing old ballast commands without changing cargo routes or results.
Expose exact per-action balance, swing, overload and damaged-landing previews before acting, including mouse/focus detail and visible touch labels.
Show current cargo, destination landing heights, stack support warnings and safe swing in a compact landing strip.
Reduce oversized scene/header spacing so the crane and controls can be viewed together; retain clear pixel-art sprites, responsive layout and reduced-motion support.
improvementPasses.validation: 23 engine + 17 DOM checks. Exact-source CI 39930163890 passed both full five-job desktop/touch campaigns, all Reefwright campaigns, persistence, restart, loss/undo and navigation. 36 screenshots (22 Counterweight, 14 Reefwright); representative Counterweight desktop/phone images reviewed.

tests: 23 engine tests: five authored three-medal routes, input/mutation isolation, ballast torque, swing/damage, cumulative stack loads, collision/clearance, failure/undo, medal records, bounded replay, corrupt saves, exact non-mutating forecasts and v1 migration.

17 DOM tests: all five campaigns via controls, keyboard guards, invalid actions, onboarding, job unlock/switch confirmation, reload, restart/cancel, unreadable-save protection, storage failure, risk labels and landing advice.

GitHub Chromium desktop 1280x1000 and touch emulation 390x844: all five jobs with three medals; every move checked against its displayed forecast; midgame reloads on all jobs; overload/loss/undo; keyboard; restart/cancel; corrupt recovery preserving an unrelated key; return navigation; no uncaught errors.
Counterweight contributes 22 screenshots; representative desktop completion and phone midgame captures visually reviewed. First job also completed through cloud-browser UI controls.

All 40 Reefwright engine/DOM checks and both complete five-coast browser campaigns pass unchanged. Public route/assets, nine first-batch source hashes, exact 20-slot gate, shell, bridge-pointer and relaxed-collection checks pass.

quality.scale: 1–5, agent design review; not player survey scores
quality.notes: Distinct deliberate crane loop: balancing reach and cargo weight while using hoist/ballast actions to damp swing, arranging cumulative-load stacks and optimizing move medals. Five compact authored jobs introduce light, heavy, long-reach, mixed-support and wind constraints. Pixel harbour and exact previews are readable in reviewed desktop/mobile captures. Simulation is discrete, not continuous pendulum physics; no sound, procedural campaign, long playtime, physical-device or full screen-reader certification is claimed.

candidates.selectionReason: Retain as a finished development candidate. Compare against the wider second-batch slate before public selection; it adds physical load-balancing and manual control distinct from Reefwright spatial ecology.

candidates.title: Lanternwake
candidates.coreLoop: Sail by placing temporary light beacons that reveal routes and attract dangerous moth swarms.

changes: Exact non-mutating next-turn previews show boat/moth positions, hull damage, oil, jars and every disappearing lantern, including newly thrown lights eaten immediately.
Optional plan-before-acting controls support tap inspection, explicit commit/cancel and keyboard Enter without spending preview turns.
Compact the desktop map and header after visual inspection so rowing controls sit closer to the chart.
Fix Enter-to-commit with focus remaining on an action button; explicitly label the turn that reaches the 180-action safety bound.
improvementPasses.validation: Final exact-source CI 39938472688 passed: 24 Lanternwake engine + 21 DOM/save tests, all five three-medal desktop and touch-emulated crossings, exact forecasts, planning/direct controls, reloads, failure/undo, restart, recovery and navigation. All Reefwright/Counterweight regressions unchanged; 58 screenshots across three games. All five Lanternwake crossings also completed through cloud-browser controls.

tests: 24 engine tests: five complete no-damage three-medal crossings; path-based illumination, expiry, oil recovery, moth choice/contact, failure/undo, bounded/forged saves, progression, permanent records and every action forecast along each reference route.

21 DOM tests: five campaigns in direct and optional planning modes, keyboard guards and Enter commitment, blocked moves, save/reload, restart/cancel, unlocks, unreadable-save protection, storage failure, danger/fading/end-of-run labels.

GitHub Chromium desktop 1280x1000 and touch emulation 390x844: all five three-medal crossings; every selected action forecast checked against actual hull/oil/jars/lights; midgame reload per crossing; loss/undo; direct/planned controls; keyboard; restart/cancel; corrupt recovery preserving another key; return navigation; no uncaught errors.

58 CI screenshots across three candidates, including 22 Lanternwake captures. Representative final desktop and phone midgame captures visually inspected. All five crossings additionally completed through cloud UI controls (first two desktop-width, last three in a 390px layout frame; not a physical-device claim).

All 80 prior Reefwright/Counterweight engine+DOM checks and their full desktop/touch campaigns passed unchanged. Local shell, bridge-pointer, relaxed-collection, route/assets, nine selected-source hashes and exact twenty-slot gate also passed.

quality.scale: 1–5, agent design review; not player survey scores
quality.notes: Light has a dual role: connected-water navigation and moth attraction. Five compact authored maps introduce expiry, oil recovery, refuges and competing swarms. Exact forecasts and optional planning make deterministic risks inspectable. Original pixel marsh art and responsive controls reviewed. No sound, procedural campaign, long-playtime claim, physical-device test or full screen-reader audit.

candidates.selectionReason: Retain as a finished candidate until the wider second-batch slate can be compared. Temporary light both enables navigation and lures hazards; distinct from Reefwright ecology, Counterweight cargo balance and first-batch cargo/stealth loops.

candidates.title: Copper Cadence
candidates.coreLoop: Hand-crank a scarce-bead percussion machine: feed unequal-length tracks, brake queued beads and rotate exits to synchronize requested notes.

changes: Non-mutating exact next-turn and three-beat pipeline forecasts expose expected notes, missing/extra notes, supply, blocked inlets and final undelivered penalties.
Animate bead travel and crank gear; respect reduced motion; preserve keyboard focus when staging controls.
Bring forecast beside crank and compact/reorder narrow layouts so score, inputs and action preview are closer.

Revise the brake-teaching score to create a genuine competing-feed constraint; an independent search proves no perfect unbraked path survives its first chord. Correct the browser harness to avoid activating the modal Close button with Space.
improvementPasses.validation: Final exact-source CI 39945625373 passed 26 Copper Cadence engine + 20 DOM checks, all five three-seal desktop/touch commissions, forecasts, reloads, audio opt-in, blocked feed, loss/undo, keyboard/Enter/Space, restart/cancel, corrupt recovery and navigation. All three prior candidates pass unchanged; 171 checks total and 80 screenshots. All five Copper Cadence commissions additionally completed through cloud UI.

tests: 26 engine tests: five perfect commissions; independent travel-time oracle; inventory conservation; atomic rejection; brake queues; in-flight routing; scoring and leftover penalties; replay-verified saves; unlocks and best-record retention; forecasts/traces/motion; exhaustive unbraked-prefix search proves the third commission needs braking for a perfect take.

20 DOM tests: five campaigns, input locks, keyboard/modal guards, focus preservation, staged controls and forecasts, midgame save/reload, restart/cancel, loss/undo, unlock navigation, corrupt-save recovery, blocked storage, optional audio/fallback and reduced-motion behavior.

GitHub Chromium desktop 1280x1000 and touch emulation 390x844: all five three-seal commissions, exact supply forecasts, midgame reload per commission, audio opt-in, blocked-feed atomicity, loss/undo, keyboard/Enter/Space, restart/cancel, isolated corrupt recovery and return navigation; no uncaught errors.

80 CI screenshots across four games, 22 for Copper Cadence. Final representative desktop/phone midgame captures inspected. All five Copper Cadence commissions additionally completed in cloud UI; first desktop-width, remaining four in a 390px layout frame (not physical-device touch testing).

All prior 125 engine/DOM checks and three desktop/touch campaigns passed unchanged. Local shell, bridge-pointer, relaxed-collection, assets, nine first-batch source hashes and exactly twenty-slot gate passed.

quality.scale: 1–5, agent design review; not player survey scores
quality.notes: Conserved beads, unequal track lengths, one feeder, queue brakes and in-flight routing make a distinct mechanical pipeline puzzle. Exact forecasts support reasoning; a revised commission now genuinely requires braking for perfection. Five compact authored commissions and seal optimization limit replay depth. Original SVG instrument and synthesized audio. No physical-device test, full screen-reader audit, subjective audio listening review or long-playtime claim.

candidates.selectionReason: Retain for comparison with the wider second-batch slate. A scarce-bead mechanical pipeline is distinct from first-batch Stone Song rhythm arrangement, Reefwright ecology, Counterweight balance and Lanternwake navigation. No automatic public selection.

candidates.title: Hollow Keeper
candidates.coreLoop: Defend a beetle settlement by carving reversible tunnels and luring invaders into traps.

changes: Added deterministic route overlays and exact remaining-wave scout reports so players can compare defenses before launching.
Added staged tool previews, explicit confirmation/cancel, projected costs and hearts; selecting fruit pauses auto march.
Preserved keyboard focus after rerenders, added Enter confirmation/Escape cancellation, and made depleted thorn beds visibly crossed out.
Moved tool selection next to the map at all viewport sizes after phone-width inspection.
improvementPasses.validation: 25 engine and 20 DOM checks pass, including exact scouts on five full campaigns, lure recrossing, stationary thorn charging, preview isolation and keyboard focus. Browser campaign verification pending.

tests: Initial version: 21 engine and 15 DOM checks passed, including all five no-damage two-wave defenses.
Improved version: 25 engine and 20 DOM checks passed. Managed-browser first hollow completed with three seals; desktop and phone-width layout inspected. Full desktop/touch CI pending.

quality.notes: Improved implementation; full Chromium regression and final quality assessment pending.
